brief.note: Casey's and ServiceTitan both fell hard on soft guidance despite beating; oil above $100 pressured everything.

candidates.name: Casey's General Stores, Inc.
candidates.business: Convenience store and fuel chain across the American Midwest
candidates.cause: Q1 beat on revenue and earnings, but management guided to a marked slowdown in fiscal 2027 profit growth and same-store sales decelerated.
candidates.right: Prepared food margins must keep growing as fuel volumes and store traffic slow
candidates.wrong: The guided profit slowdown proves the start of a longer deceleration, not a reset

candidates.name: ServiceTitan, Inc.
candidates.business: Software for plumbing, heating and electrical contractors to run their businesses
candidates.cause: Q2 revenue rose 21% and beat, but third-quarter revenue guidance came in just below consensus and brokers flagged decelerating growth.
candidates.right: Growth must stop decelerating before the market re-rates a software business at this price
candidates.wrong: Trade contractors cut software spend and revenue growth keeps stepping down each quarter

candidates.name: Fair Isaac Corporation
candidates.business: Owns the FICO credit score and sells analytics software to lenders
candidates.cause: The federal housing regulator told Fannie Mae and Freddie Mac to accept rival VantageScore credit scores, opening FICO's mortgage-scoring monopoly to competition.
candidates.right: Lenders must stick with FICO scores despite now being free to switch
candidates.wrong: VantageScore takes mortgage share and FICO loses pricing power on its best scores

candidates.name: lululemon athletica inc.
candidates.business: Athletic apparel brand selling leggings and activewear through its own stores
candidates.cause: Cut full-year guidance for the third time, now seeing sales fall 5% to 7% and EPS near $9.60, with China continuing to disappoint.
candidates.right: Product newness must revive North American demand before discounting erodes the brand
candidates.wrong: Competitors keep taking share and a fourth guidance cut follows this one
